title: feat(mcp): query_records and get_record name the fields field-level security withheld from the caller
body:
Fixes #35137

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Security-touching: yes

The card's two remaining halves have their own carriers: the ask-data skill line is carried by #35191, and the example-app scenario question by #35113. This PR is the framework half, built on the maintainer's ruling A recorded on the card (comment 6977609191): keep the bound.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的 `query_records` 与 `get_record` 在调用者有字段被字段级安全挡掉、而该字段又在调用者自己的 schema 里可见时,结果里多带 `withheldFields`(只给字段名,不给值)和一句固定说明;HTTP 与 stdio 两个入口一致。本轮:「调用者 schema 里有哪些字段」这一半改为直接取 `describe_object` 返回给该调用者的那份字段列表。
- 为什么改:之前被挡掉的字段在行里直接消失,AI 客户端把它读成「空」;现在免于 schema 遮罩的调用者(D4)或关了 schema 遮罩的部署会被告知「对你不可见」,默认遮罩下的普通成员则永远不会被点名(该字段对他们不存在),即裁决 A。
- 风险与回滚:只读、只加结果成员,无人被挡时结果逐字节不变;安全线是「调用者 schema 里看不到的字段永不点名」,由 `withheldFieldNames` 的求交一行和本轮的同源字段列表共同守住,各有消融证明;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` 的 `describeForCaller` 与 `fieldVisibilityOf`;`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` 的 `describeForPrincipal` 与 `fieldVisibilityOf`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `withheldFieldNames`(`served.has` 一行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/query-records-withheld-fields.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `McpDataBridge` gains an optional member, `fieldVisibilityOf(object)`, answering two framework answers asked as the caller: the field names the caller's own served schema shows, and the security service's readable answer for them (`getReadableFields`). Both bridges implement it.
- The served-schema field list now comes from the same projection `describe_object` serves. Each door's `describe_object` answer is built by one local function (`describeForCaller` on the HTTP bridge in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `describeForPrincipal` on the stdio bridge in `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`), and `fieldVisibilityOf` reads its field names off that answer (`describedFieldNames`), so any later filter on what `describe_object` lists applies to `withheldFields` too.
- The shared tool layer (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) names a field as withheld only when the served schema shows it and the readable answer leaves it out; with `fields` in the call only asked fields are candidates. When the list is non-empty, the result carries `withheldFields` and `withheldFieldsNote` (one constant sentence, `WITHHELD_FIELDS_NOTE`). When it is empty, nothing is added. A missing member, an `undefined` answer or a throw adds nothing and never fails the read.
- Who is told (ruling A): a caller served the whole schema (ADR-0106 D4 exempt) or any caller where object-schema masking is switched off (D8). A plain member under default masking is never told: the field does not exist in their schema.
- `query_records` and `get_record` descriptions gain one sentence about the member.
- `aggregate_records` is unchanged: measured on the real security layer, a withheld field asked as a measure or a group is already refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (see Verification).
- No change to what field-level security withholds; no write path touched; no new security-service method (the existing `getReadableFields` is the caller-scoped answer).

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/query-records-withheld-fields.test.ts` (new): the tool layer over the HTTP runtime, and the stdio bridge behind the real tools. Pins: a withheld field named with the note; a field the served schema does not show never named anywhere in the serialized result, even when asked for in `fields`; a readable field with an empty value not named; only asked fields named; nothing withheld means no member and a byte-identical answer; a bridge that cannot answer or throws names nothing; the member beside a delegation narrowing. On stdio: a D4-exempt caller is told; a member under default masking whose schema hides the field never sees it named; with masking off (D8) the member is told; no security service means no member; and (round 2) the served list follows `describe_object`'s field names on an object where the two could differ.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`, on the real security layer (`SecurityPlugin` over `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver`): the D4-exempt author's served list equals `describe_object`'s field names and the denied field is withheld; the member under default masking is answered nothing; (round 2) with masking off the member's served list equals `describe_object`'s field names and the denied field is withheld; an unrestricted member is withheld nothing and no security service answers nothing. And (round 2), on the real engine, the pin "served equals `describe_object`'s field names" extended to an object where the two could differ.
- The two bridge-member classification tripwires register the new member.

Choice stated: a caller with nothing withheld gets no member (not an empty list), so its result is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruled persona: the card's done-when is met for a D4-exempt caller or a masking-off deployment, each pinned on both doors above; the plain-member-under-default-masking persona is never told, also pinned on both doors.
- `get_record` keeps the two members on the record object, beside its field keys (contract review N2, judged and left): moving them beside the record would mean wrapping it (for example a `record` key) only when something is withheld, so where the record sits in the answer would change with the caller's field security, a shape split every client would have to branch on. The existing precedent for a notice on these tools (the delegation narrowing) also adds keys on the answer object. No collision is possible: field machine names are snake_case, these members camelCase.
- The note text lives in one constant (`WITHHELD_FIELDS_NOTE`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`) so a shared result-sentence locale picker can adopt it later; this PR adds no picker and does not touch `truncated`.

## Verification

The stdio CONTROL pin's engine fixture has no `count`, so main serves that page as `{ object, records, hasMore: false }` with no `total`. The pin at `packages/mcp/src/query-records-withheld-fields.test.ts` now expects exactly that shape; its point is unchanged: no `withheldFields` member, no note, and the readable answer asked as the principal.
- The other pins in that file and in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` were checked for the same drift on the merged tree: none (results below).
